actors.name: Ashvale University Annual-Fund Caller
actors.private_context: The caller has a script for first-time asks and a list of alumni to contact. They are scheduled to call Dr. Renata Sousa during this shift. They have no prior relationship with Renata.

actors.name: Dr. Renata Sousa
actors.private_context: Renata is an alumna of Ashvale University who has never donated. She has her own financial priorities and may or may not be receptive to a phone solicitation. She does not know the caller.

shared_context: Ashvale University's annual fund is conducting a phone campaign. The caller will place a call to Dr. Renata Sousa at her known phone number. The call may be answered, go to voicemail, or be ignored. If answered, the caller will make a first-time ask for a pledge. Renata may pledge any amount, decline, or ask to be contacted later. The campaign runs until the end of October 2026.

starting_events.description: The Ashvale University annual-fund caller begins their shift and prepares to call Dr. Renata Sousa.

resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that Dr. Renata Sousa made a pledge (any amount) to Ashvale University's annual fund before 2026-10-31T21:00:00-03:00. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
